subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: TikTok and Teen Data
description: A fast breakdown of TikTok and Teen Data for builders.

hook.text: TikTok knows how long teens watch each video, what makes them swipe, and what keeps them awake.

buildup.text: The app collects device info, location, keystroke patterns, and browsing data from its youngest users.

discovery.text: TikTok was fined $5.7 million for violating COPPA by collecting data from children under 13.

twist.text: The fine was less than TikTok earns in a single day. It's a parking ticket for a billionaire.

climax.text: Millions of teens pour their attention into an app that treats their behavior as raw material.

punchline.text: Teens make the content. TikTok takes the data.

quiz.question: Why was TikTok fined $5.7 million?
options: For illegally collecting data from children under 13
For allowing adult content on the platform
